notes:
Summary: CulturaLink is a Pan-EU contact center platform that provides multilingual CX orchestration for SaaS customers. They want agent-assist + ticket summarization as immediate wins, with downstream goals of fully automated triage and region-aware tone adaptation. Primary ask: robust behavior under spikes (Black Friday style volume in retail customers), strict EU data residency, and per-customer tone profiles (formal/informal/regional idioms).

Requirements (high level):
- Languages: EN, DE, FR, ES, PT-BR, NL, IT, JA (pilot scope EN/DE/FR/ES).
- Latency targets: agent-assist p95 <= 250ms for short-turn tokens; end-to-end ticket summarization (full ticket) <= 4s.
- Throughput: baseline 800 concurrent agent-assist sessions, burst capacity to 2000 concurrent (2.5x).
- Cost sensitivity: want to compare cost per ticket vs current baseline (Azure-hosted models). Target ARR impact positive within 12 months.
- Integration: Salesforce + in-house ticketing, function/tool-calling to update tickets and trigger macros.
- Privacy/residency: EU-only storage for customer messages, SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 2y.

POC plan (current):
- 2026-02-28: POC kickoff (2-week). Goal: prove latency & tone fidelity for FR/DE + routing failover.
- Tests: 1) latency under 800 concurrent; 2) tone-scoring against annotated set (customer-supplied 1.2k examples); 3) tool-calling reliability (Salesforce create/update 99.9% success).
- Redwood deliverables: quantization profile suggestion, batching config, routing policy template, initial cost projection.

Recent timeline (CRM-style bullets):
- 2026-01-30: Inbound demo from Marketing lead. Initial interest in agent-assist + multilingual auto-summaries.
- 2026-02-10: Technical scoping call. SE requested sample ticket corpus (de-identified).
- 2026-02-15: CulturaLink submitted security questionnaire (Drive link).
- 2026-02-28: POC kickoff meeting (ff-20260228-poc-kickoff). SE/E2E eng pairing scheduled.
- 2026-03-04: Engineering sync — discussed KV caching for session continuity across agents, model routing rules per region, and fallback to smaller quantized variants under overload.
- 2026-03-05: Redwood provided quantization + batching recs and simple cost model for 6 months.

Customer quotes / takeaways: "We cannot compromise on European data residency — SOC2 + KMS mandatory"; "Tone must adapt by locale (German formal, Spanish more colloquial) — we need examples in outputs".

POC success criteria: 
- p95 latency <= 250ms for agent-assist at baseline concurrency,
- region-aware tone score improvement >= 20% vs baseline (measured by human raters),
- cost per ticket at or below existing infra for 80% of workloads.

Integrations & technical notes:
- Function-calling: need reliable idempotent calls to Salesforce with retry semantics.
- Routing: prefer policy-based routing (latency first in EU west, cost fallback to quantized model in EU central).
- Caching: prefix caching for repeated KB lookups; want Redwood Optimize to recommend TTLs.
